card.line: The Vale of Siddim was a valley, also called the Salt Sea, where five kings fought four kings and lost, leading to Lot's capture.

moments.title: Five kings gather for battle
moments.text: The kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela came as allies to the Valley of Siddim. There they lined up against Chedorlaomer and the three kings with him, four kings against five.

moments.title: Kings fall into the tar pits
moments.text: The valley was full of tar pits. As the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some men fell into the pits, and the survivors escaped to the hill country.
